sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate is semantically supported: the validator requires owner-correct design/resistance obligations and an orientation-to-maximum-load relationship, while the candidates provide only component classes, a string orientation value, or an unlinked boolean confirmation.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: the graph reduces the requirement to ship-level string/presence records and a boolean confirmation, without faithfully checking that the steering mechanism, unit fitting, and thruster body withstand plastic blade bending without damage, or explicitly representing the blade-loss orientation that produces the maximum load on the studied component. The load case contains only a confirmation flag and is not linked to the recorded orientation or a component/load comparison, so it is an accidental presence-only approximation of the required relationship and comparison.
